Healthcare soft: ABT (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -14.26%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -11.15%) BELOW TREND.

Major divergence present: MSFT (1W: -4.16% | 1M: +10.33%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +10.62%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.89% | 1M: +5.57%) CORRECTION — treat as tactical noise not a clear directional signal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with rotation and pockets of strength; AAPL (1W: +4.98% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -4.16% | 1M: +10.33%) CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +10.62%) CORRECTION. Sector is positive on the week (Technology: 24 stocks; 1W: +4.44%) but leadership uneven — watch follow-through on hyperscaler and AI-related catalysts.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed-to-soft: V (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +6.16%) ABOVE TREND but JPM (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +4.72%) CORRECTION and MA (1W: -2.08% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND; Financials are flat-to-weak on the week (Financials: 20 stocks; 1W: -0.09%). No broad breakout in bank leadership — selective exposure to names with clear earnings or margin beats.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Soft overall: LLY (1W: +13.14% | 1M: +6.67%) ABOVE TREND is a bright spot, while ABT (1W: -7.13% | 1M: -14.26%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -11.15%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -0.98% | 1M: -6.40%) BELOW TREND weigh on sector (Healthcare: 17 stocks; 1W: -0.63%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Stay selective in a NEUTRAL environment: favor high-conviction ABOVE TREND leaders (INTC, QCOM, GOOGL, LLY) and cyclical stocks showing follow-through (CAT, MPC); reduce exposure to names showing clear BELOW TREND action (SHOP, CHTR, LOW). Style: Growth/Momentum tilt at the margin but tempered by major-cap CORRECTIONs — monitor divergences.

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**

BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -7.82% | 1M: +10.62%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.89% | 1M: +5.57%) CORRECTION, SHOP (1W: -11.81% | 1M: -9.40%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**

QCOM (1W: +24.37% | 1M: +48.37%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through on hyperscaler wins will confirm continuation. AAPL (1W: +4.98% | 1M: +9.78%) ABOVE TREND — sustain above recent range to signal market internals improving.

SHOP (-45): slowing growth headline; SHOP (1W: -11.81% | 1M: -9.40%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. ## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt, given mixed sector breadt h (6/11 positive) and concentrated weekly leaders. INTC (1W: +27.96% | 1M: +112.98%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +24.37% | 1M: +48.37%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +11.05% | 1M: +29.48%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.
